Riverton Square Lottery | Newly Renovated Residences in a Harlem Oasis

A Unique Opportunity for Long-Term Housing Stability

Riverton Square is Harlem’s premier apartment enclave featuring newly renovated one bedroom and two bedroom no fee residences. An enclosed community with 12 acres of freshly landscaped tranquil park space, Riverton Square offers residents elevator buildings with 24-hour security, on-site laundry facilities, a children’s playground with water features, a basketball court, and a private community center serving school-age children and seniors of the property. Our spacious apartments feature gourmet kitchens with sleek cabinetry and countertops, and stainless steel appliances, as well as elegant baths with ceramic tile detail and modern fixtures.

You Could Live Here, Apply by October 4th

The Riverton Square Lottery is a rare and limited opportunity for eligible applicants to lock-in affordable long-term housing stability in Manhattan’s coveted and historic Harlem community. If your pre-tax combined household income falls between $49,097 and $130,375, you may qualify for an affordable Riverton Square apartment. Apartments are available for immediate move-in, and the Riverton Square team will work with qualifying applicants whenever possible to accommodate schedules and preferred move-in dates. Once you move in, the apartment is yours for the long term. Your circumstances and income may change but your home will not. There is no income recertification in the future.
